flowElements.headingText: Direct File doesn’t support every tax situation. You’ll need to find other ways to file your federal taxes if:
flowElements.rawXml:
Direct File doesn’t support every tax situation. You’ll need to find other ways to file your federal taxes if:
  • You had types of income that we don’t support yet
  • Someone in your tax household didn’t have Medicaid, Medicare, or other health insurance coverage for all of unless you qualify for an exception
  • You need to calculate your retirement income using the Three-Year Rule or General Rule
  • You want to claim credits or deductions for higher education tuition costs, interest paid on an NJCLASS student loan, or contributions to an NJBEST 529 college savings account

flowElements.headingText: You can file your federal taxes only as a paper tax return.
flowElements.rawXml:
You can file your federal taxes only as a paper tax return.

You said you have an IRS-assigned IP PIN that you’re unable to retrieve at this time.

You can file your taxes only as a paper tax return because you’re missing an Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN).

Paper returns can take up to 6 weeks to process.

You need an IP PIN to confirm your identity. If you have an IP PIN but can’t find it, you won’t be able to file your tax return electronically.

Try following these instructions to get your IP PIN. Once you have the IP PIN you’re looking for, add it to Direct File .

If you need assistance, chat with customer support.

flowElements.headingText: You can’t be claimed as a dependent
flowElements.rawXml:
You can’t be claimed as a dependent

You said you and want the opportunity to claim tax benefits like dependents, tax credits, and other deductions you may qualify for and don’t want anyone else to be able to claim you as dependents.

If someone has already filed their federal tax return claiming you as a dependent, they’ll need to file an amended return to remove you as a dependent.

flowElements.headingText: You can’t be claimed as a dependent
flowElements.rawXml:
You can’t be claimed as a dependent

No one will be able to claim you as a dependent because you said you and want the opportunity to claim tax benefits like dependents, tax credits, and other deductions you may qualify for and don’t want anyone else to be able to claim you as dependents.

You told us earlier that someone is claiming you as a dependent, but no one is able to claim you.

If someone has already filed their federal tax return claiming you as a dependent, they’ll need to file an amended return to remove you as a dependent.

If you or would like to be claimed as a dependent, you can update your choice .

<Fact path="/isTaxpayerCannotBeClaimedAndWillNotBeClaimedOrIncomplete">
  <Description>Screen gate: isTrue(/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed) and isFalseOrIncomplete(/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed"/>
      </All>
      <Any>
        <Not>
          <IsComplete>
            <Dependency path="/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed"/>
          </IsComplete>
        </Not>
        <Not>
          <Dependency path="/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed"/>
        </Not>
      </Any>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

<Fact path="/isTaxpayerCannotBeClaimedAndIsWillBeClaimed">
  <Description>Screen gate: isTrue(/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed) and isTrue(/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/taxpayerCannotBeClaimed"/>
      </All>
      <All>
        <IsComplete>
          <Dependency path="/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed"/>
        </IsComplete>
        <Dependency path="/primaryFiler/willBeClaimed"/>
      </All>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
